description: Construct-coverage allowlist for constructcheck/run.js. DENY BY DEFAULT: a key in `allow` means a human has verified that construct converts correctly on a real migrated page (source AsciiDoc -> MDX). Keys are `category:token` exactly as the gate reports them. Add a key only after checking the construct on the page(s) the gate cites. `notes` is a sibling map (key -> one-line evidence for why it was trusted); the gate ignores it, it is the audit trail.

notes.ast-context:paragraph:
->

. Layer-1 normalized text matches golden on all 314 migrated pages (cloud+operator).
notes.ast-context:section: -> ##/### headings. Layer-2 heading counts match per level (h2-h6 exact) on all 314 pages.
notes.ast-context:preamble: lead content before first section -> plain paragraphs; text-backed (create-account, add-kafka-mapping).
notes.ast-context:ulist: -> `-` bullets. listItems count exact on all 314; nesting depth (fidelity-blind) verified: kafka 3-level, operator phone-homes 2-level.
notes.ast-context:olist: -> `1.`. listItems count exact on all 314; nesting verified create-account / create-kafka-connection.
notes.ast-context:list_item: -> <li>. Layer-2 listItems count exact on all 314 pages: nothing dropped or added.
notes.ast-style:olist:arabic: top-level ordered list -> decimal, matches golden arabic on all 314 pages.
notes.ast-style:olist:loweralpha: nested ordered lists render decimal (Docusaurus/CommonMark standard), NOT AsciiDoc a/b/c. Deliberate decision 2026-08-11: keep markers matched to the source markdown; no CSS override. Nesting itself is preserved (create-budget-tracker: separate nested <ol>).
notes.ast-context:admonition: AsciiDoc admonition block -> Docusaurus :::type. Both source forms verified: inline `NOTE:` and block `[NOTE]`+====/--. 29 cloud pages.
notes.ast-style:admonition:NOTE: -> :::note. Inline + block + list-continuation forms (create-account, invite-user, delete-account).
notes.ast-style:admonition:IMPORTANT: -> :::important. `important` registered as a custom admonition keyword in docusaurus.config (extendDefaults) so the type name survives 1:1 (backup-and-restore).
notes.ast-style:admonition:WARNING: -> :::warning. Block title case fixed 2026-08-11: convertAdmonition now emits :::warning[Title] from the .title div instead of demoting it to a body paragraph (migrate-to-cloud, queue). Verified in rendered DOM.
notes.bracket-style:tabs: [tabs] -> <Tabs>. cloud: create-account/create-serverless-cluster/get-started. operator: get-started, connect-outside-kubernetes (language tabs), incl. tab sets nested inside list items.
notes.ast-style:example:tabs: tab-styled example block -> <Tabs>/<TabItem value=slug label=term>. Same witnesses as bracket-style:tabs (cloud+operator).
notes.ast-context:example: ==== block. No plain/standalone example blocks exist in EITHER component (no bare [example] in source); every ==== is a tabs / admonition / collapsible container, all verified.
notes.delimited-block:example: ==== delimiter, same as ast-context:example: only ever a tabs/admonition/collapsible container (cloud+operator).
notes.ast-context:dlist: both roles verified in BOTH components: as a tab-set source ([tabs]+dlist) and as a genuine description list -> <dl>/<dt>/<dd> (cloud maploader-and-mapstore, operator high-availability-mode).
notes.delimited-block:open: -- open block. cloud: only ever tab content. operator: tab content + list-item grouping; blockOrInline handles nested blocks. Verified get-started (both components).
notes.ast-context:table: convertTable: inline cells + single header row -> GFM pipe table; block content / multi-row-header -> semantic <table> with markdown cell bodies. Cell text + table count fidelity-backed on all 314 pages.
notes.delimited-block:table: |=== table delimiter, same handling as ast-context:table.
notes.bracket-style:anchor: [[id]] -> id on the following heading (## Heading {/* #id */}). Every cloud anchor precedes a heading; anchor resolution also gated by refcheck + fidelity Layer 3. (cluster-side-modules: serializers/prereqs/deploy).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"1a: column spec, 'a' = AsciiDoc block content -> forces semantic <table> with markdown cells (cluster-side-modules [cols=1a,2a]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"20: column spec with %width + 'a' block -> <table>; width % dropped (accepted per table-rework) (cloud data-structures, operator).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"3: mixed plain/'a' widths -> <table> where any 'a' cell has block content (cluster-side-modules [cols=3,3a,4a,1a]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"h: 'h' = header column -> <th> preserved in tbody rows when routed to htmlTable by block content (maploader [cols=h,2,4]). NOTE: an h-column table with only inline cells would downgrade to a pipe table and lose row-headers; none exist in the corpus.
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"1: plain equal widths, inline cells -> GFM pipe table; widths dropped (operator [cols=1,1]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"25: 'm' monospace + 'a' block (operator [cols=25%m,75%a]): m column -> inline `code`, verified jvm-parameters.
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"30: same m+a class as cols=25 (operator management-center-clusters [cols=30%m,70%a]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"4: plain widths + options=header -> GFM pipe table with header row (operator api-ref [cols=4,8,4,2,4]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"5: plain widths + options=header -> pipe table (operator api-ref [cols=5,10]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"l: 'l' = literal column -> single-line literal cells render as inline `code` in a pipe table (operator image-registry [cols=l, l]).
